submission_method.value: Submit directly through the BCBid platform where the RFP is posted; no physical submission unless specifically requested.

contract_term.value: ERP implementation plus a 5-year licensing and support agreement, with an option for Cowichan Tribes to extend on the same terms and conditions; extension length is not specified.

scope_of_deliverables.value: Implement a commercially supported cloud ERP covering Finance, Procurement, HR, Payroll and Asset Management; include data conversion, integrations, implementation/change management, security, and transition to ongoing support. Other TIFIS functions such as housing/membership remain outside the replacement scope.
scope_of_deliverables.note: Invitation and Appendix B Narrative Response / Requirements.

value: Submit by the deadline using the prescribed BCBid method.
Completed and signed Submission Form in PDF.
Completed Narrative Response in PDF following Appendix B Section A.
Support Canadian organizations, including Canadian taxes and payroll.
Vendor experience implementing solutions for First Nations in Canada.
Solution hosted in Canada with all data stored in Canada.
Implementation vendor(s) with at least 5 years of experience implementing Finance, HR, Payroll and Asset Management solutions.
mandatory_technical_requirements.note: Appendix B Section D; failure results in disqualification.

evaluation_criteria.note: Appendix B Section F; total 100 points.

minimum_score_threshold.note: Explicit category thresholds are stated in Appendix B Section F.

pricing_structure.value: Complete the provided Pricing Sheet for implementation, licensing and support over five years; CAD, inclusive of applicable duties/taxes, and all-inclusive of labour, materials, travel, insurance, delivery, installation/setup and overhead. Also provide resource rates for additional scope. Pricing is worth 15 points.

insurance_requirements.note: The RFP says pricing must include insurance costs but does not state a minimum insurance coverage type or dollar amount in the PDF.

vendor_experience_required.value: Mandatory experience implementing solutions for First Nations in Canada, and implementation vendor(s) must have at least 5 years of experience implementing Finance, HR, Payroll and Asset Management solutions.

references_required.note: Narrative Response Section 11: implementations involving the proposed solutions in Canada; First Nations clients preferred.

value: Describe compliance with industry security standards and management of privacy/cybersecurity risks.
data_security_requirements.note: Appendix B Sections A8 and D.

data_hosting_residency.value: The solution must be hosted in Canada and all data must be stored within Canada.
data_hosting_residency.note: Appendix B Section D mandatory technical requirements.

vendor_demonstration_required.note: Stage V Vendor Demonstrations; demonstration is worth 30 points and has a 21/30 (70%) threshold.
